page_title: FIO 2-1 BOL | Fiorentina v Bologna 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) takes a mid-range free kick and looks to threaten the goalkeeper, but the ball goes way wide of the left post.
90+5' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+4' Sydney van Hooijdonk (Bologna) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Fabio Maresca blows for a foul.

90+2' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Fabio Maresca with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90+2' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yerry Mina (Fiorentina) replacing Giacomo Bonaventura.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
88' Here's the change. Cristiano Biraghi leaves the pitch and Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) comes on as a substitute.
87' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) commits a rough challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
85' Fabio Maresca has a clear sight and sees a foul from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina).
83' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Sydney van Hooijdonk (Bologna) replaces Joshua Zirkzee.
81' Rough tackle by Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Sam Beukema (Bologna) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) comes onto the pitch so that Arthur Melo can be given a rest.
77' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
76' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Stefan Posch and he is replaced by Jhon Lucumi (Bologna).
76' Substitution. Victor Kristiansen did his best and is replaced by Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna).
75' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
75' Fabio Maresca blows for a foul after Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
74' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Fabio Maresca blows for a foul.
73' The game is interrupted. Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
70' We are about to witness a substitution. Nikola Moro (Bologna) is replacing Remo Freuler.
70' Here is a change. Riccardo Orsolini is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Dan Ndoye (Bologna).
69' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Fabio Maresca has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
67' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
66' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) takes the corner which is cleared.
65' The resulting corner from Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) comes to nothing.
64' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Fabio Maresca no option but to blow his whistle.
63' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Bologna as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

61' Play continues despite the shouts by some Bologna players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Fabio Maresca interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
60' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
59' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) heads on.
53' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
53' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) commits a rough foul. Fabio Maresca stops the game and makes a call.
51' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Fabio Maresca saw the whole situation.
50' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
48' 2 - 1 Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) slots home the penalty after firing the ball in the opposite direction to which the goalkeeper dives!
48' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
47' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) is penalised for holding. Fabio Maresca signals a set piece. The referee makes the call - penalty to Fiorentina!
46' Half-time substitution. Vincenzo Italiano decided to make a change. Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is replaced by Luca Ranieri.
46' Vincenzo Italiano has made a change at the break. Jonathan Ikone has come on in place of M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Bologna due to an offside in the build-up play.
45+5' Wait! Referee Fabio Maresca has indicated he is going to review the Bologna goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
45+5' Goal Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna)! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) was put through by Lewis Ferguson and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the left side of the net. 2:1.
45+2' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
45+2' Yellow card. Michel Aebischer (Bologna) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
40' Referee Fabio Maresca has finally had enough of Thiago Motta and brandishes a yellow card at him!
40' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) trips an opposition player and Fabio Maresca signals a foul.
39' A cross into the box picks out Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the left post.
36' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) gets a yellow card.
33' 1 - 1 Goal! Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) puts the penalty low into the middle of the goal and past Pietro Terracciano.
33' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) is going to take the penalty!
32' The Bologna players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
31' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Bologna! Let's see what he decides.
30' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
29' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Dangerous play by Victor Kristiansen (Bologna). Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) climbs highest in the middle of the box after a cross from the wing, but sends a good looking header narrowly wide of the left post.
22' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!

17' 1 - 0 Goal! M'Bala Nzola shows great vision to find Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the top right corner. 1:0.
11' Stefan Posch (Bologna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Pietro Terracciano intercepts the ball.
9' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
1' The match has just started.
Fiorentina will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Fabio Maresca.
